    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Evanstonian" name="The Evanstonian" processRef="Process_RoomService"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_RoomServiceCall"
                      name="Calls room service"
                      sourceRef="Participant_Guest"
                      targetRef="StartEvent_RoomServiceCall"
                      messageRef="Message_RoomServiceCall"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_RoomService" name="Room service order" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_RoomService">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Manager" name="Room-service manager">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_RoomServiceCall</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_TakeOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SubmitKitchenTicket</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_OrderSommelier</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AssignWaiter</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_PreparationSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Kitchen" name="Kitchen">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PrepareFood</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Sommelier" name="Sommelier">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AlcoholIncluded</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PrepareAlcoholicBeverages</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AlcoholMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Waiter" name="Waiter">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_WaiterPreparationSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReadyCart</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PrepareNonalcoholicDrinks</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_WaiterPreparationJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_PreparationJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DeliverOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReturnToStation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_BillingDecision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_WaitToBill</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_BillingMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DebitGuestAccount</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_OrderComplete</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_RoomServiceCall" name="Guest calls room service">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_RoomServiceCall" messageRef="Message_RoomServiceCall"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TakeOrder" name="Take down order"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SubmitKitchenTicket" name="Submit order ticket to kitchen"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OrderSommelier" name="Give order to sommelier"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssignWaiter" name="Assign order to waiter"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PreparationSplit" name="Start concurrent preparation" gatewayDirection="Diverging"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareFood" name="Prepare food"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AlcoholIncluded" name="Alcoholic beverage included?" gatewayDirection="Diverging">
      <bpmn:documentation>80% of room-service orders include wine or another alcoholic beverage.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareAlcoholicBeverages" name="Fetch wine from cellar and prepare alcoholic beverages"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AlcoholMerge" name="Continue after sommelier preparation decision" gatewayDirection="Converging"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_WaiterPreparationSplit" name="Prepare cart and nonalcoholic drinks" gatewayDirection="Diverging"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReadyCart" name="Ready cart with tablecloth and silverware"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareNonalcoholicDrinks" name="Prepare nonalcoholic drinks"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_WaiterPreparationJoin" name="Cart and nonalcoholic drinks ready" gatewayDirection="Converging"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PreparationJoin" name="Food, beverages, and cart ready" gatewayDirection="Converging"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_DeliverOrder" name="Deliver prepared order to guest's room"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReturnToStation" name="Return to room-service station"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BillingDecision" name="Another order to prepare or deliver?" gatewayDirection="Diverging"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_WaitToBill" name="Wait to do billing"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BillingMerge" name="Continue to billing" gatewayDirection="Converging"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DebitGuestAccount" name="Debit guest's account"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_OrderComplete" name="Order billed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_TakeOrder" sourceRef="StartEvent_RoomServiceCall" targetRef="Task_TakeOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TakeOrder_SubmitTicket" sourceRef="Task_TakeOrder" targetRef="Task_SubmitKitchenTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SubmitTicket_OrderSommelier" sourceRef="Task_SubmitKitchenTicket" targetRef="Task_OrderSommelier"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderSommelier_AssignWaiter" sourceRef="Task_OrderSommelier" targetRef="Task_AssignWaiter"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AssignWaiter_PreparationSplit" sourceRef="Task_AssignWaiter" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PreparationSplit_Kitchen" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_PrepareFood"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PreparationSplit_Sommelier" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Gateway_AlcoholIncluded"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PreparationSplit_Waiter" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Gateway_WaiterPreparationSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Kitchen_PreparationJoin" sourceRef="Task_PrepareFood" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AlcoholIncluded_Prepare" name="Alcoholic beverage included" sourceRef="Gateway_AlcoholIncluded" targetRef="Task_PrepareAlcoholicBeverages">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">orderIncludesAlcoholicBeverage</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AlcoholIncluded_Skip" name="No alcoholic beverage" sourceRef="Gateway_AlcoholIncluded" targetRef="Gateway_AlcoholMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrepareAlcoholic_AlcoholMerge" sourceRef="Task_PrepareAlcoholicBeverages" targetRef="Gateway_AlcoholMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AlcoholMerge_PreparationJoin" sourceRef="Gateway_AlcoholMerge" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WaiterSplit_Cart" sourceRef="Gateway_WaiterPreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_ReadyCart"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WaiterSplit_NonalcoholicDrinks" sourceRef="Gateway_WaiterPreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_PrepareNonalcoholicDrinks"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Cart_WaiterJoin" sourceRef="Task_ReadyCart" targetRef="Gateway_WaiterPreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NonalcoholicDrinks_WaiterJoin" sourceRef="Task_PrepareNonalcoholicDrinks" targetRef="Gateway_WaiterPreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WaiterJoin_PreparationJoin" sourceRef="Gateway_WaiterPreparationJoin" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PreparationJoin_Deliver" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin" targetRef="Task_DeliverOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Deliver_Return" sourceRef="Task_DeliverOrder" targetRef="Task_ReturnToStation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Return_BillingDecision" sourceRef="Task_ReturnToStation" targetRef="Gateway_BillingDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BillingDecision_Wait" name="Another order to prepare or deliver" sourceRef="Gateway_BillingDecision" targetRef="Task_WaitToBill">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">anotherOrderToPrepareOrDeliver</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BillingDecision_NoWait" name="No other order" sourceRef="Gateway_BillingDecision" targetRef="Gateway_BillingMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WaitToBill_Merge" sourceRef="Task_WaitToBill" targetRef="Gateway_BillingMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BillingMerge_Debit" sourceRef="Gateway_BillingMerge" targetRef="Task_DebitGuestAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Debit_End" sourceRef="Task_DebitGuestAccount" targetRef="EndEvent_OrderComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

rules.instruction: When the description names multiple required activities without specifying their order and states that a later outcome depends on all of them: Model the activities as parallel branches and synchronize them before that outcome.
rules.situation: the description says a shared activity is followed by work assigned to multiple roles that can proceed concurrently, and a later outcome depends on all of that work

rules.instruction: When the description explicitly identifies a role or participant as responsible for performing an activity: Represent that responsibility in the corresponding activity label or in the responsible lane; do not leave the responsibility unrepresented when the description states it.
rules.situation: the description explicitly identifies the role or participant responsible for an activity

rules.instruction: When the description identifies a role or group as responsible for performing an activity: Label the corresponding BPMN activity so that the stated responsibility remains clear, without adding unstated details.
rules.situation: the description assigns an activity to a specific role or participant

rules.instruction: When the description presents distinct activities in an ordered progression, including transitions into, through, or out of branches or synchronization points: Connect each consecutive activity with a sequence flow, preserving the stated transitions through branches and synchronization points.
rules.situation: the description states an order or dependency between distinct activities or gateways, including transitions into or out of branches or synchronization points.
